findings.evidence: TaskSequencer timer sx keeps color: isOvertime ? brandTokens.colors.gremlinPink : 'inherit' while only the fontFamily changes to brandTokens.fonts.display.

findings.summary: Zone geometry and deriveStatus disagree at the exact 0.6 and 0.8 edges. The needle at 60% and 80% sits on the next zone (PRESSURE, BREAK) while the text stays in the previous band (Flow Ritual, Pressure Build).
findings.evidence: ZONES widths are 30/30/20/20. toPercent keeps whole percents when deriveStatus(whole/100) matches. LoadInstrument.test.tsx expects load 0.6 to read 60% Flow Ritual and load 0.8 to read 80% Pressure Build. deriveStatus treats high as >0.6 and critical as >0.8.

risks.summary: A state_update replaces the whole CognitiveReading. Omitted fields become null. A GET forecast in predicted_load_15min is cleared by a later socket snapshot that lacks that field. App.tsx comments and realtimeStateMapping.test.ts lock this full-snapshot behavior. Partial socket payloads will blank energy, attention, forecast, or recommendation that an earlier GET had shown.

TaskSequencer and TeamDashboard still render a fixed sample queue and team board. The visible label is [SAMPLE] not connected, and the false [LIVE] / consent-verified copy is gone. Those controls remain operable mock workflows.

validation_status is NOT_RUN. Tests, typecheck, ESLint, and GitHub workflow status were not executed. The diff adds ui-dashboard/eslint.config.js and does not add a workflow that runs it. Whether flat/recommended and react-hooks flat configs match the installed packages is unconfirmed. Candidate markdown claims of passing tests or remaining lint counts were not used as evidence.

index.css drops the Google Fonts import and sets font-synthesis:none. No @font-face or font files are in the diff. The cockpit uses Dopemux Term and Dopemux Editor only when those families are already installed; otherwise it falls back to system fonts at Regular weight.

Closed socket and failed GET copy uses the word Failed inside a warning alert and the gilt [DEGRADED] chip. Parse and task failures use the red error banner. Hard outage and degraded waiting share one yellow treatment.

handleRetry sets liveReadingSeenRef to false before the effect detaches the previous socket. A message already queued on that socket can set the ref true again and cause the replacement GET to be ignored.

time.test.ts assigns process.env.TZ at module load and expects America/Los_Angeles clock output. Runtime TZ changes are not reliable on every Node or Vitest worker, so the 07:01:55 assertion is host-sensitive.
claudedocs/design/ui-dashboard-audit-2026-10-30.md is candidate-authored. It names an auditor and asserts typecheck, lint, and test results. Those statements were reviewed only as data.

rationale: The supplied diff for DDD-Enterprises/dopemux-mvp PR 1486 at trusted head 0c031b26589f5ae07bc1a6801387b7c02f8e73ff (base 97b6d5040496e2271c41d24c339d039303bbe6b1) removes invented cognitive defaults. DashboardApp starts from EMPTY_READING. asRatio accepts only finite numbers in [0,1]. asOneOf accepts only the engine energy and attention enums. mapAggregateState nulls recommendation when task_recommendations carries an error. App.test.tsx asserts that a rejected fetch plus a closed socket shows unknown energy and attention, names GET http://localhost:8097/api/adhd-state, and does not render 70% or 60%. The same file covers stale GET versus socket ordering, upstream section errors, malformed state_update, and critical-panel collapse. index.css removes the body::after scanline and the universal transition. Consent is the static string [CONSENT: UNKNOWN]. Sample surfaces are labelled [SAMPLE] not connected. Git object identity, CI, and test execution were not rechecked; judgment is of this diff only.
